titulo: What Happens If You Stop Drinking Water #shorts
premisa: Segunda persona, escalada temporal de lo que le pasa a tu cuerpo si dejas de beber agua. Guion aproximado (50-58 s): 'Day three without water. Your blood is thick as syrup, and your heart is pounding just to push it.' / 'Rewind. Hour one: you feel nothing. But you're already losing water just by breathing.' / 'Hour eight: you've lost 1 percent of your body water. Thirst finally kicks in. Your brain was warned first.' / 'Hour twenty-four: down 2 to 3 percent. Your focus drops. Your brain tissue literally shrinks.' / 'Day two: your kidneys go into emergency mode. Your pee turns dark. Then almost stops.' / 'Your mouth runs dry. No saliva. No sweat. Your body stops cooling itself.' / 'Day three: your blood volume drops, your heart races, and your blood pressure crashes. Stand up? You black out.' / 'Lose 10 percent, you get confused. Past 15, your organs start shutting down.' / 'Most people last about three days. In a desert, less than one.' / 'In 1979, Austrian police locked 18-year-old Andreas Mihavecz in a cell. Then they forgot him.' / 'He licked condensation off the walls.' / 'Eighteen days. Guinness still lists it as the longest anyone has survived without food and water.' [corte]
gancho: Day three without water. Your blood is thick as syrup, and your heart is pounding just to push it.
